day1_intro.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
day1_intro.text: Chur bro, just here loadin' up a mean bag of chips and a pie before the footy, ay! Gotta keep the tank sweet for all the hits.

end_day1.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
end_day1.text: Sweet bro, catch ya after the game. Gotta see if the Warriors actually show up tonight!

day2_intro.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
day2_intro.text: Ey saw my cuz Tane in here earlier. Good kid that one, just mixed up with the wrong crowd, ay.

tane_connection.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
tane_connection.text: Yeah grew up with his older brother. Whole family's connected to the Gumboots, bro. Just how it is round here.

end_day2.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
end_day2.text: Mean chat bro, I’ll catch you round. Stay outta the drama, ay.

day3_intro.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
day3_intro.text: Heard Tane's trying to move some product for the boys. Good opportunity if you're smart about it, bro.

gang_money.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
gang_money.text: Boss looks after his people, bro. Just don't cross him. Seen what happens to snitches.

end_day3.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
end_day3.text: Anyway, I better bounce. Got a few errands before kickoff. Later, cuz.

day4_intro.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
day4_intro.text: Just here for the usual, bro. Gotta keep the energy up for training.

end_day4.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
end_day4.text: Alright bro, stay steady. Things are heating up round here.

day5_intro.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
day5_intro.text: Just grabbing some snacks before the game, bro. Warriors better not choke this time.

end_day5.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
end_day5.text: See ya round bro, something’s brewing… stay ready.

day6_intro.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
day6_intro.text: Big game tonight bro! Gotta load up on all the goods.

end_day6.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
end_day6.text: Stay sharp bro, streets been wild lately.

day7_intro.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
day7_intro.text: Last pie before the big final! Gotta represent the boys.

end_day7.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
end_day7.text: That’s me bro, time to back the boys. Catch ya on the flipside.
